query: Who nominated the only Featured Article on English Wikipedia about a dinosaur that was promoted in November 2016?

used_evidence: FunkMonk was the nominator for the Giganotosaurus article during its Featured Article candidacy. (source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Featured_article_candidates/Giganotosaurus/archive1)

tasks.description: Find information about the Featured Articles on English Wikipedia that were promoted in November 2016, specifically focusing on dinosaurs.

result.query: Find information about the Featured Articles on English Wikipedia that were promoted in November 2016, specifically focusing on dinosaurs.

facts.fact: The only Featured Article on English Wikipedia about a dinosaur that was promoted in November 2016 is Giganotosaurus.
Giganotosaurus is considered one of the largest known meat-eating dinosaurs and possibly one of the largest terrestrial carnivores to have ever existed.
FunkMonk was the nominator for the Giganotosaurus article during its Featured Article candidacy.

result.summary: In November 2016, Giganotosaurus was promoted as the only dinosaur-related Featured Article on English Wikipedia, nominated by FunkMonk. It is recognized as one of the largest carnivorous dinosaurs.
